name: 78217 · San Antonio, TX
findings: ZIP 78217 (San Antonio) has 154 nonprofit organizations. 61 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 48 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78217 (San Antonio) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
